CREATE FUNCTION CDN.ECODCenaZamowienia( @lTyp as smallint, @lNumer as int, @lCenaUzgodniona as Decimal(15,4), @sWalutaE as char(3), @sWalutaS as char(3), @dData as int) Returns Decimal(19,4) Begin Declare @lWynik Decimal(19,4) Declare @lTypKursu int Declare @lKursL_n decimal(12,4) Declare @lKursM_n decimal(12,4) Declare @sZanWaluta char(3) Declare @lDataWazn int Declare @lNrKursu int
if @sWalutaE = @sWalutaS set @lWynik = @lCenaUzgodniona else Begin
Select @lTypKursu = ZaN_TypKursu, @sZanWaluta = ZaN_Waluta, @lDataWazn = ZaN_DataWaznosci, @lKursL_n = ZaN_KursL, @lKursM_n = ZaN_KursM, @lNrKursu = ZaN_NrKursu From CDN.Zamnag Where ZaN_GIDTyp = @lTyp and ZaN_GIDNumer = @lNumer
If (@lTypKursu = 2 or (@lTypKursu = 3 and @lDataWazn >= @dData/86400+69035)) begin If (@sWalutaE <> @sZanWaluta) Select top 1 @lKursL_n = isnull(ZaV_KursL,1),@lKursM_n = isnull(ZaV_KursM,1) From CDN.Zamvat Where ZaV_GIDNumer = @lNumer and ZaV_Waluta = @sWalutaE; end Else begin SELECT top 1 @lKursL_n = isnull(WaE_KursL,1) , @lKursM_n=isnull(WaE_KursM,1) FROM CDN.WalElem WHERE WaE_Symbol=@sWalutaE AND WaE_Lp=@lNrKursu AND WaE_KursTS<=@dData ORDER BY -WaE_KursTS end
Set @lWynik = @lCenaUzgodniona * (@lKursL_n/@lKursM_n) end return @lWynik end
